title: Patient Financial Account — Schedule B, Statement Cycle, Final Notice and Agency Placement Figures
content:
These are the per-class figures of the Patient Financial Account that govern how often statements go out while a balance is owed, how many may go unpaid before the final notice, how long the final-notice period runs, the smallest past-due balance that may be placed with the outside collection agency, and the residual at or below which a balance is written off administratively at the final-notice step.

| Financial class (tier) | Statement cycle (calendar days) | Unpaid statements before final notice | Final notice to agency placement (calendar days) | Placement minimum (USD) | Small-balance write-off level (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | 30 | 3 | 30 | 75.00 | 4.99 |
| Self-Pay Account | 28 | 3 | 30 | 50.00 | 9.99 |
| Medicare Part B Account | 30 | 4 | 30 | 50.00 | 4.99 |
| Medicare Advantage Account | 30 | 4 | 30 | 50.00 | 4.99 |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | 30 | 3 | 30 | 50.00 | 4.99 |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | 30 | 3 | 30 | 50.00 | 4.99 |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | 30 | 3 | 30 | 50.00 | 4.99 |

### Definitions used in this schedule

- **Statement cycle** — calendar days between two consecutive patient statements while a balance is owed.
- **Unpaid statements before final notice** — the number of consecutive statements that may go unpaid before the final notice is issued.
- **Final notice to agency placement** — calendar days from the final notice to placement with the outside collection agency.
- **Placement minimum** — the minimum past-due balance that may be placed with the collection agency; a smaller balance stays in-house.
- **Small-balance write-off level** — the remaining balance at or below which the account's residual is written off at the final-notice step instead of escalating.

### Notes on the figures

1. The Self-Pay Account is the only class on a 28-day cycle; every other class is on a 30-day cycle.
2. The Medicare Part B Account and the Medicare Advantage Account allow 4 unpaid statements; every other class allows 3.
3. The placement minimum is 75.00 on the Medicaid Managed Care Account and 50.00 on every other class. As a hypothetical comparison, a past-due balance of 60.00 is at or above the minimum on the Commercial PPO/POS Account and below it on the Medicaid Managed Care Account.
4. The write-off level is 9.99 on the Self-Pay Account and 4.99 on every other class; a residual of exactly 4.99 on a Commercial HMO/EPO Account is at the level, a residual of 5.00 is above it.
